title: Cannabis joint during a 2008 National Council debate
description: In 2008, while taking part in a debate on cannabis legalisation, Wermuth (then a JUSO figure) smoked a joint to demonstrate support for decriminalisation, an act that drew media attention and criticism.

title: Term-limit exemption controversy within SP Aargau
description: SP Aargau applies internal term limits for its mandates; the party granted Wermuth exemptions to run again for the National Council, which commentators and critics described as preferential treatment.

title: 'Verkackt' attack on FDP federal councillors over EU negotiations
description: At an SP delegates' assembly in May 2021, Wermuth sharply attacked FDP federal councillors over the handling of the EU framework-agreement negotiations using blunt language, drawing media commentary.
